ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 75% high-intensity (white/cream) surface area versus 25% low-intensity (black) boundary pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white regions occupy the central expanse of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated at the medial junction, extending along the trailing edges. A distinct circular low-intensity spot is visible on the lower interior quadrant of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 48 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, jagged serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-15 pixels along the entire trailing edge boundary, appearing more irregular on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with initial concavity originating from the median notch, transitioning to convex curvature as the lobe extends toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, granular clusters of high-intensity pixels (white/yellow-tan) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single prominent vertical linear low-intensity disruption (black streak) located on the upper-right section of the right lobe, extending approximately 40 pixels from the trailing edge inward.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical linear marking on the right lobe; extensive calcified-looking clusters at the extreme lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A solitary, well-defined circular black focal point situated in the lower-middle white field of the left lobe.
